
{{alias}}( value )
    Tests if an input value is an axis instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Value to test.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating if an input value is an axis instance.

    Examples
    --------
    > var opts = { 'scale': 'xScale', 'orient': 'bottom' };
    > var v = new {{alias:@stdlib/plot/vega/axis/ctor}}( opts );
    > var bool = {{alias}}( v )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( {} )
    false

    See Also
    --------
